en-US.description:
Send a fax in 60 seconds. No machine. No store. Right from your iPhone.

FaxJet is the fastest way to send a fax from your phone. Snap a photo of your document, enter the fax number, hit send — we handle the rest.

Why professionals use FaxJet:
• Send unlimited faxes anywhere in the US
• Delivery confirmation on every transmission
• HIPAA-compliant, 256-bit encrypted gateway
• Auto-deskew, sharpen, and convert paper documents with your camera
• Optional cover page with To / From / Subject / Message
• PDF delivery receipt with confirmation number

Perfect for medical forms, legal documents, insurance claims, tax filings, and any paperwork your clinic, lawyer, or accountant still asks for by fax.

IMPORTANT — FaxJet is a paid subscription app. An active subscription is required to send faxes.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS

FaxJet offers two auto-renewing subscription options to send unlimited faxes anywhere in the United States:
• Unlimited Weekly — $9.99 per week, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
• Unlimited Monthly — $19.99 per month

A one-time pay-per-fax option is also available for $4.99 per fax (no subscription).

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

We respect your privacy. Documents are encrypted in transit and never stored on our servers — they're sent only to your fax recipient. Built by professionals, for professionals.
